*F-PRF, F-PRP* (Pseudorandom function, permutation) is part of *Cryptographic Library and Symmetric Primitives* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: an emerging formulation, still an active area of research.

Treated as a single entry: pseudorandom functions and permutations are folded together here, the same way *F-COT* and *F-ROT* are below.

*References:*

- Küsters and Tuengerthal. [*Ideal key derivation and encryption in simulation-based security*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2010/295). In Topics in Cryptology – CT-RSA 2011, volume 6558 of LNCS, pages 161–179, 2011.
